name: Port Scan Stream
note: Streaming nmap-style port table: rows fly in one at a time, states colour-coded (open/filtered/closed), hash progress bar and elapsed clock, then a scan summary before it loops. Ships with seeded rows so it reads as finished even before the JS attaches.
html:
nmap -sS -T4 10.0.4.170.00s
PORT STATE SERVICE
22/tcpopenssh OpenSSH 8.9
23/tcpfilteredtelnet
80/tcpopenhttp nginx 1.24
443/tcpopenhttps nginx
[··················]0%

name: Hash Cracker
note: Password-cracking rig: the candidate string locks character by character behind a blinking block cursor while the attempts counter, rate and ETA run and the hash bar fills, ending in a flashing KEY FOUND banner before it resets.
html:
jtr --wordlist+rulesbcrypt
$2b$12$K9fQ.eLp/7u3Xz1aVb0mSe
try>·············█
[······················]0%

** KEY FOUND **

name: Packet Capture
note: Live tcpdump feed: colour-chipped protocols, src-to-dst endpoints and byte lengths scroll upward under a pulsing capture LED, with a block-character throughput sparkline and running packet/drop counters.
html:
tcpdump -i eth0 -nnpromisc
.114TCP10.0.4.17:443 → 10.0.4.99:514221460
.186UDP10.0.4.99:53 → 10.0.4.2:5396
.241ARP10.0.4.2 → 10.0.4.9942
.307TCP172.16.8.41:22 → 10.0.4.17:49721344
▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁0pkt0 drop

name: SSH Login Banner
note: Typewriter SSH session: the connect command types out, the key fingerprint prints, the password fills in as dots, then a box-drawn MOTD warning banner drops in above a live root prompt with a blinking block cursor. Lines scroll rather than clearing, so the pane is never empty.
html:
$ ssh -p22 root@10.0.4.17
ED25519 SHA256:9c+Xq7VbT1n…
root@10.0.4.17's password: ••••••••
root@node-07:~# █

name: Redacted Secrets
note: Classified key vault: values sit behind solid redaction blocks under a hazard-striped classification banner, and one row at a time is declassified with a green scan sweep that reveals it character by character before the bars slam back down.

name: Hex Dump Viewer
note: Live hexdump pane: offsets, eight-byte rows and an ASCII gutter split by a box-drawing rule, with bytes flickering as memory changes, a cyan cursor row sweeping down and a DEADBEEF signature burning amber when the scan reaches it.
html:
hexdump -C core.dmp0x00a0
0000a04d 5a 90 00 03 00 00 00│MZ......
0000a804 00 00 00 ff ff 00 00│........
0000b0b8 00 00 00 00 00 00 00│........
0000b840 00 00 00 00 00 00 00│@.......
sigscanning…
